mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate S&P 500 declines within 5 trading days as risk aversion rises.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE increases by over 0.5pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and consumer spending indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production during manufacturing contraction cycles accelerates output slowdowns, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is declining for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 2.0% year-over-year signals accelerating inflation, prompting immediate Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by over 2.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth (PAYEMS rising for three consecutive months) strengthens consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is rising for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, declining consumer spending (RSAFS) signals imminent demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as growth fears mount.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS declines in late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous drops in industrial production and housing starts indicate broad supply-side stress, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as recession risks spike.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative 5-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year window.
